body: Backlog follow-up to Apple #11297 (timer stopped since it killed a live match via the matchmaker restart). Added a guard before the systemctl restart: pgrep -f for any running red_garden_arena_server process (only exists between lobby-full and match-end/timeout) defers the restart and skips marking the SHA deployed, so the next 5-min timer tick retries until a genuinely idle window. Binaries still publish either way since the matchmaker execs fresh per spawn. Timer intentionally left stopped pending a live verification pass before re-enabling.
title: fix: auto_deploy.sh is now match-aware, safe to re-enable after verification
